title: Navy pilots recall “unsettling” 2004 UAP sighting
summary: A 60 Minutes segment in which Navy pilots Dave Fravor and Alex Dietrich recount their 2004 encounter with the 'tic tac' UAP during training with the USS Nimitz group.
why: Cited in UFO threads as a short, first-hand pilot account worth hearing, even without papers or data.
